formulas.formula: Track every dollar you spend, see where it goes, and stay inside your budget.
1. Categories: type the year, then your spending categories with a group and a monthly budget for each.
2. Still on Categories: list how you pay (debit card, credit card, cash...).
3. Expenses: add a row every time you spend: date, what, category, amount, how you paid.
4. Month View: pick a month to see budget vs. spent by category, your top 10 expenses and more.
5. Calendar: pick a month to see what you spent each day, plus your no-spend days.
6. Year Summary and Payment Methods: every category and every card, month by month.
7. Recurring: list the bills and subscriptions that repeat, and see what they cost a month and a year.
8. Dashboard: your whole year at a glance, with charts.
Got money back? Log it as a negative amount in the same category.
Essentials = must-pay, Lifestyle = choices, Financial = debt and fees. See where your money really goes.
A '?' on Expenses means the category isn't on your Categories list (a typo?).
On Expenses, select columns B to H from row 6 down and press Delete. Keep your categories.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: under budget, or a no-spend day.
Yellow: close to your budget (90% or more).
Red: over budget, or something to check (a typo or an unknown category).
Thank you for your purchase! Every dollar you track is a dollar you control.
